messages:
Ava: who's up for a tiny 'micro-safari' this weekend? thinking tide pools + coffee. low-key. anyone? :shell:
Miguel: love that. low tide looks best sat ~11am — https://tide.example/forecast Sat 11.
Priya: i'm in for coffee after. can we bring dogs? :dog:
Samir: out this weekend (family stuff) but salsa class saturday night for anyone who wants to pretend they're coordinated :dance:
Taylor (OpsBot): Heads up — rooftop reserved request from team A is pending for Sun 4-7pm. please confirm via the calendar link.
Ava: oh right, rooftop potluck is on the calendar. hmm — tide pools sat, rooftop sun? keeps it chill.
Miguel: sounds good. i can bring a thermos of strong coffee + binoculars :binoculars:
Priya: i'll bring a loaf and two travel mugs :bread: :coffee:
Samir: if anyone wants a 30-min salsa crash course before the rooftop potluck, i'm happy to run a quick basics session at 5pm sat? (rooftop or nearby community room) :salsa:
Ava: @Samir legend. people will come for that and stay for potluck energy. :tada:
Jess: can someone pick up folding chairs? i can bring plates and utensils.
Miguel: i can grab 6 folding chairs from storage on sat morning.
Priya: also tagging facilities to confirm rooftop reservation + power for the speaker.
facilities-bot: Reminder — rooftop use requires form submission 48h before event. Submit here: https://internal.example/forms/rooftop-use
Jess: ok i'll submit the form later today. anyone want to coordinate dish assignments? potato salad, chips, dessert?
Priya: i'll DM the potato salad recipe to whoever wants it (low-sodium).
Ava: nice. quick poll: tide pools sat 11am vs sat 2pm? react with :one: or :two: and i'll pick the majority.
Miguel: :one:
Priya: :one:
Jess: :two: (i'm flexible)
Samir: :two: (time-zone dance)
Ava: looks like 11am wins. cool — meeting spot: pier parking lot. i'll post a tiny map and meetup pin.
Taylor (OpsBot): FYI — noise curfew on rooftop is 9pm. keep it friendly.
Ava: noted. see y'all saturday!
